method: Calibration-only PCA, smoothing, removal of the first two components, cosine interval retrieval, and slope-constrained DTW. Final sequences interpret overlapping word and phrase evidence. Reproducible scripts, alternatives, and alignments are saved locally in ANALYSIS.md and reconstruction_evidence.json. Algorithm-only sequences are saved separately in algorithm_only_predictions.json and *_algorithm_only.json. No network, external labels, or pretrained decoder was used.
limitations: Word identities, counts, and boundaries remain uncertain; these are best reconstructions rather than verified transcripts.
Lowest confidence: tda989373, t4f16b000, and t62254eda. Unusual phrases were retained where supported by neural matches.
